cards.text: Jesus and His disciples come to the region of Caesarea Philippi. There He asks them a question: "Who do people say the Son of Man is?" I bet every disciple turned to the guy next to him like, "You go first."

cards.question: The disciples tell Jesus what people are saying about Him. Which name do some people say?

cards.text: John the Baptist was the man who baptized people in the Jordan River (Matthew 3:6), and others say Elijah, Jeremiah or one of the prophets. Everybody's got a different answer. It's the whole break room trying to figure out the new manager.
Then Jesus turns it around: "But what about you?" And then: "Who do you say I am?" Ohhh. No more "people say." Now it's YOUR turn.

cards.question: Jesus asks His disciples who they say He is. What does Simon Peter, one of His disciples, answer?

cards.text: Peter goes all the way: "You are the Christ, the Son of the living God." Somebody asks ME a question that big, I'm still clearing my throat.

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter, "Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah!" Who does Jesus say revealed this to Peter?
Jesus says Peter learned who He is from flesh and blood.

cards.text: Then Jesus tells him, "you are Peter, and on this rock I will build My church." Me? The only thing anybody ever built on me was a pile of old takeout menus in a junk drawer.

cards.question: Jesus says the gates of ___ will not prevail against His church.
Jesus tells Peter, "I will give you the ___ of the kingdom of heaven."

cards.text: Whatever Peter binds on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever he looses on earth will be loosed in heaven. I shared a junk drawer with a mystery key that spent YEARS guessing which door it opened, and nobody ever told HIM a thing!

cards.question: Now that the disciples know, Jesus tells them to tell everyone that He is the Christ.

cards.text: From that time on, Jesus begins to show His disciples what's ahead. He must go to Jerusalem, suffer many things at the hands of the elders, chief priests and scribes, and be killed.

cards.question: Jesus says He must suffer and be killed in Jerusalem. What does He say happens on the third day?

answers.text: He will be raised to life
He will appear in the temple

cards.text: Peter hears all this. Then Peter, the same Peter Jesus just called blessed, takes Jesus aside.

cards.question: When Peter takes Jesus aside, he begins to rebuke Him.

cards.text: Peter says, "Far be it from You, Lord!" and "This shall never happen to You!" Friend, that's the new guy at work pulling the owner aside to explain how the business runs.
But Jesus turns and says to Peter, "Get behind Me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to Me."

cards.question: Jesus tells Peter, "For you do not have in mind the things of God, but the things of ___."

cards.text: Then Jesus tells His disciples what it takes to come after Him. Anyone who wants to must deny himself.

cards.question: Jesus says anyone who wants to come after Him must deny himself and follow Him. What must he take up?
Jesus says, "For whoever wants to save his life will ___ it."
Jesus says whoever loses his life for His sake will find it.

cards.text: Then Jesus asks about a man who gains the whole world. The WHOLE world, friend. I couldn't even get the whole junk drawer.

cards.question: Jesus asks, "What will it profit a man if he gains the whole world, yet forfeits his ___?"

cards.text: Then He asks, "what can a man give in exchange for his soul?" I shared a drawer with an expired coupon that thought it could buy ANYTHING, and even he wouldn't try that trade.
Jesus says, "For the Son of Man will come in His Father’s glory with His angels."

cards.question: When the Son of Man comes in His Father's glory with His angels, what does Jesus say He will do?

answers.text: Repay each one for what he has done
Gather only His disciples to Him

cards.text: Jesus has one more thing to tell the people standing there with Him, and it starts with "Truly I tell you." When He starts like that, friend, you lean in.

cards.question: Jesus says some who are standing there will not taste death before they see something. What is it?

answers.text: The Son of Man coming in His kingdom

findings.problem: This story card has 3 sentences: the John the Baptist line joined to the other names, 'Everybody's got a different answer.' and the break room joke. Only the opening card can run to 3 sentences.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: Elijah and Jeremiah show up here for the first time in the walkthrough, but the card doesn't say who they are. John the Baptist gets an introduction and they don't.

rule.text: New people. The first time someone shows up, he says simply who they are, like "Cyrus, king of Persia" or "Moses, Israel's leader."

findings.problem: This story card has 5 sentences: 'Then Jesus turns it around: ...', 'And then: ...', 'Ohhh.', 'No more "people say."' and 'Now it's YOUR turn.'

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: This story card has 3 sentences: the verse 18 quote line, 'Me?' and the takeout menus joke.

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess the exact word in Jesus' line ('gates of Hades'). No earlier card gives anything to reason from, and 'Rome' or 'Babylon' would seem just as likely. This tests wording the baker hasn't seen, not meaning.

rule.text: The rule against guessing the next words of a line (see below) applies to every passage, and to fill in the blank too. The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

findings.problem: The blank asks the baker to guess the word 'keys' inside a direct quote. No earlier card sets up binding, loosing or doors, so 'crown' or 'throne' look just as likely. The only way to get it right is to already know the verse or to get lucky.

rule.text: The check: could a thoughtful baker who has only seen the earlier cards make a reasoned pick? If the only way to get it right is luck, give the story card more context or ask a different question.

findings.problem: This story card has 3 sentences: 'Then Jesus asks about a man who gains the whole world.', 'The WHOLE world, friend.' and 'I couldn't even get the whole junk drawer.'

rule.text: Every other story card is 1 to 2 sentences.

findings.problem: The joke 'I couldn't even get the whole junk drawer' doesn't click. Papa Dorin never wanted to own or gain the drawer, so the comparison to gaining the whole world is unclear and needs explaining.

rule.text: It clicks instantly for any adult, with no explaining.

findings.problem: This story card is only 'Jesus says,' plus the verse 27 quote. It has no Papa Dorin voice and no storyteller framing. It reads as a bare verse, not as Papa Dorin telling the passage.

rule.text: Short, but not stripped down. A story card still has enough of Papa Dorin's voice and enough context that the moment makes sense.
